prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art NPC emotional eye atlas for a retro RPG portrait
Primary request: Create a 2-by-2 atlas of only this portrait's upper 64x35 face region. Cells in row-major order: OPEN eyes, HALF-CLOSED eyes, CLOSED eyes, repeat of OPEN eyes. The last cell repeats open eyes so the atlas has four equal cells.
Input image: Use only the provided exact NPC074 eyes reference grid as the visual guide for the face, native pixels, narrow low-set eye geometry, pale original iris highlights, skin and hair palette, blue ornament, spacing and framing.
Subject: The same long light-brown/blond-haired fantasy NPC with the blue ornament at the left edge. Make the eye expression read clearly sad, not angry or afraid.
Style/medium: Crisp restrained 1990s pixel-art portrait, with hard clean pixel clusters matching the reference. No antialiasing or smoothing.
Composition/framing: Exact 2x2 atlas, equal cells each with 64:35 landscape aspect and identical crop/framing. Preserve head scale, eye spacing, hairline and blue ornament registration across all cells. No gaps, borders, labels or text.
Constraints: Sadness comes from a subtle lift of the inner brow ends and soft downcast upper lids, not a hard V, extra dark brow, duplicate shadow brow or angry crease. Keep the existing narrow aperture and small pale-gray iris/highlight scale; keep pupils compact, coherent and stationary across open, half and closed phases. Half-lids gently lower over the same eyes. Closed lids remain natural and sad, with the same brow and skin colors. Preserve the muted warm skin and hair palette. Change only the eye and brow expression inside the eye contour. Keep hair, forehead, ornament, face outline, nose, mouth, clothing/background and all exterior pixels unchanged. Avoid broad white bands, oversized or round pupils, alert wide eyes, bright highlights, blurred brow edges, painted gradients, extra details, watermark or antialiasing.
